(“MSCI” or the “Company”) (NYSE: MSCI), a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community, today announced its financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026 (“third quarter 2026”) and nine months ended September 30, 2026 (“nine months 2026”). Financial and Operational Highlights for Third Quarter 2026 (Note: Unless otherwise noted, percentage and other changes are relative to the three months ended September 30, 2025 (“third quarter 2025”) and Run Rate percentage changes are relative to September 30, 2025). • Operating revenues of $892.0 million, up 12.4%; Organic operating revenue growth of 12.3% • Recurring subscription revenues up 7.7%; Asset-based fees up 24.9% • Operating margin of 56.3%; Adjusted EBITDA margin of 62.2% • Diluted EPS of $4.86, up 14.4%; Adjusted EPS of $5.11, up 14.3% • Organic recurring subscription Run Rate growth of 8.7%; Retention Rate of 95.0% • In third quarter 2026 and through October 19, 2026, a total of $627.2 million or 1,116,460 shares were repurchased at an average repurchase price of $561.81 • Approximately $147.5 million in dividends were paid to shareholders in third quarter 2026; Cash dividend of $2.05 per share declared by MSCI Board of Directors for fourth quarter 2026 Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended Sep. 30, Sep. 30, Sep. 30, Sep. 30, in millions, except per share data (unaudited) 2026 2025 % Change 2026 2025 % Change Operating revenues $ 892.0 $ 793.4 12.4 % $ 2,609.8 $ 2,311.9 12.9 % Operating income $ 502.1 $ 447.6 12.2 % $ 1,446.5 $ 1,249.9 15.7 % Operating margin % 56.3 % 56.4 % 55.4 % 54.1 % Net income $ 351.0 $ 325.3 7.9 % $ 1,099.0 $ 917.6 19.8 % Diluted EPS $ 4.86 $ 4.25 14.4 % $ 15.09 $ 11.87 27.1 % Adjusted EPS $ 5.11 $ 4.47 14.3 % $ 14.59 $ 12.63 15.5 % Adjusted EBITDA $ 554.8 $ 494.4 12.2 % $ 1,598.0 $ 1,394.4 14.6 % Adjusted EBITDA margin % 62.2 % 62.3 % 61.2 % 60.3 % “In the third quarter MSCI delivered strong financial and operating metrics, including our best-ever recurring net-new sales in Analytics and Private Capital Solutions, our best-ever Q3 recurring net-new sales in Index, and another record quarter for asset-based fees. Among client segments and regions, we achieved our best-ever quarter both with asset owners and in Asia-Pacific,” said Henry A. Fernandez, Chairman and CEO of MSCI. “Thanks to these results, we entered Q4 with solid momentum and strong client engagement across our franchise. Notably, we have seen robust demand for both our traditional and newer solutions. All of this shows that MSCI is expanding our foundational, mission-critical role in global investing even as we transform our business for today’s AI-first world,” Fernandez added. 1 Third Quarter Consolidated Results Operating Revenues : Operating revenues were $892.0 million, up 12.4%. Organic operating revenue growth was 12.3%. The $98.6 million increase was the result of $49.1 million in higher asset-based fees, $44.5 million in higher recurring subscription revenues and $5.0 million in higher non-recurring revenues. Run Rate and Retention Rate : Total Run Rate at September 30, 2026 was $3,571.9 million, up 12.1%. Recurring subscription Run Rate increased by $209.5 million, and asset-based fees Run Rate increased by $175.9 million. Recurring subscription Run Rate growth was primarily driven by asset managers, hedge funds and banking & brokerages client segments, and record ETF AUM linked to MSCI indexes. Organic recurring subscription Run Rate growth was 8.7%. Retention Rate in third quarter 2026 was 95.0%, compared to 94.7% in third quarter 2025. Expenses : Total operating expenses were $389.9 million, up 12.8%. Adjusted EBITDA expenses were $337.2 million, up 12.8%, primarily reflecting higher non-compensation costs as a result of higher information technology costs, professional fees and market data costs. Additionally, we saw higher compensation and benefits costs primarily driven by higher incentive compensation and salaries, partially offset by increased capitalization of costs related to internally developed software projects. During the third quarter of 2026 we recognized $6.1 million of Adjusted EBITDA expenses and $1.9 million of intangible asset amortization expense related to the Compass, Vantager, PM Insights and First Street acquisitions. Total operating expenses excluding the impact of foreign currency exchange rate fluctuations (“ex-FX”) and adjusted EBITDA expenses ex-FX increased 13.2% and 13.4%, respectively. Operating Income : Operating income was $502.1 million, up 12.2%. Operating income margin in third quarter 2026 was 56.3%, compared to 56.4% in third quarter 2025. Headcount : As of September 30, 2026, we had 6,259 employees, reflecting a 0.1% increase, with 29% and 71% of employees located in developed market and emerging market locations, respectively. Other Expense (Income), Net : Other expense (income), net was $74.2 million, up 45.2%, primarily driven by higher interest expense as a result of higher debt levels. Income Taxes: The effective tax rate was 18.0% in third quarter 2026 compared to 17.9% in third quarter 2025. The increase was primarily driven by a lower operating tax rate in the current year that was offset by smaller net discrete tax benefits compared to the prior year. Net Income : As a result of the factors described above, net income was $351.0 million, up 7.9%. Adjusted EBITDA : Adjusted EBITDA was $554.8 million, up 12.2%. Adjusted EBITDA margin in third quarter 2026 was 62.2%, compared to 62.3% in third quarter 2025. 2 Index Segment : Table 1A: Results (unaudited) Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended Sep. 30, Sep. 30, Sep. 30, Sep. 30, in millions 2026 2025 % Change 2026 2025 % Change Operating revenues: Recurring subscriptions $ 269.5 $ 242.5 11.1 % $ 786.7 $ 711.5 10.6 % Asset-based fees 246.6 197.5 24.9 % 704.2 559.0 26.0 % Non-recurring 16.5 11.1 48.6 % 49.0 37.2 31.7 % Total operating revenues 532.6 451.1 18.1 % 1,539.9 1,307.7 17.8 % Adjusted EBITDA expenses 120.2 100.9 19.1 % 354.5 315.7 12.3 % Adjusted EBITDA $ 412.4 $ 350.2 17.8 % $ 1,185.4 $ 992.0 19.5 % Adjusted EBITDA margin % 77.4 % 77.6 % 77.0 % 75.9 % Index operating revenues were $532.6 million, up 18.1%. The $81.5 million increase was primarily driven by $49.1 million in higher asset-based fees and $27.0 million in higher recurring subscription revenues. Organic operating revenue growth for Index was 18.0%. Index Run Rate as of September 30, 2026, was $2.1 billion, up 16.5%. The $294.8 million increase was comprised of a $175.9 million increase in asset-based fees Run Rate and a $118.9 million increase in recurring subscription Run Rate. The increase in asset-based fees Run Rate was primarily driven by higher AUM in both ETFs linked to MSCI equity indexes and non-ETF indexed funds linked to MSCI indexes. The increase in recurring subscription Run Rate was primarily driven by growth from market cap-weighted and custom Index products. The increase reflected growth across all client segments, primarily driven by growth from asset managers, banking & brokerages and hedge funds. The increase also reflected growth across all regions. Organic recurring subscription Run Rate growth for Index was 11.7%. Organic operating revenue growth for All Other – Private Assets was 6.7%. All Other – Private Assets Run Rate was $310.9 million as of September 30, 2026, up 8.9%. The $25.5 million increase was primarily driven by Private Capital Solutions related to Total Plan Manager, Private Capital Transparency Data and Private Capital Intel products. The increase reflected growth across all regions and was primarily driven by the asset owners and asset managers client segments. Organic recurring subscription Run Rate growth for All Other – Private Assets was 9.2%. 4 Select Balance Sheet Items and Capital Allocation Cash Balances and Outstanding Debt : Cash and cash equivalents were $261.0 million as of September 30, 2026. MSCI typically seeks to maintain minimum cash balances globally of approximately $225.0 million to $275.0 million for general operating purposes. Total principal amounts of debt outstanding as of September 30, 2026, were $6.8 billion. The total debt to net income ratio (based on trailing twelve months net income) was 4.9x. The total debt to adjusted EBITDA ratio (based on trailing twelve months adjusted EBITDA) was 3.2x. MSCI seeks to maintain total debt to adjusted EBITDA in a target range of 3.0x to 3.5x. Capex and Cash Flow : Capex was $50.7 million, and net cash provided by operating activities decreased by 3.0% to $436.1 million, primarily reflecting higher cash paid for interest, partially offset by higher cash collections from customers. Free cash flow (non-GAAP) for third quarter 2026 was down 8.9% to $385.4 million.
